profileText: a Delegate from New Hampshire; born at Salmon Falls, Strafford County, N.H., July 17, 1745; prepared for college by private tutors; graduated from Harvard College in 1768; studied law; admitted to the bar and commenced practice in Dover, N.H., in 1771; register of probate of Strafford County, N.H., 1773-1787; appointed on January 10, 1774, a member of the committee of correspondence; member of the New Hampshire state house of representatives, 1776-1780; appointed in June 1777 a member of the New Hampshire state committee of safety; served as moderator, 1777-1786; Delegate to the Second Continental Congress, 1778; signed the Articles of Confederation; member of the New Hampshire state council, 1780-1784; served in the New Hampshire state senate, 1784-1786; died in Dover, N.H., on January 10, 1787; interment in Pine Hill Cemetery.
